author: Screen Junkies
description:
We got invited to the junket for Netflix’s new movie War Machine, starring Alan Ritchson and directed by Patrick Hughes. It’s about a prospective Army Ranger going toe to toe with a giant killer robot, but can these big boys go toe to toe with our giant stupid questions?

Voice: Jon Bailey the EPIC VOICE GUY (@epicvoiceguy on all socials)
